about: Rakovina Therapeutics Inc., a biopharmaceutical research company, engages in the research and development of cancer treatments that target DNA-damage response systems. The company develops kt-2000 series, which are patented class of oral, small molecule PARP inhibitors with established in vitro and in vivo proof of concept; kt-3000 series drug candidates, which are bi-functional targeted small molecules designed to inhibit both PARP and histone deacetylase; and kt-4000 series, which are small molecules engineered to induce targeted DNA damage in tumor cells. It is also involved in the development of kt-5000 series of brain-penetrant dual ATRmTOR inhibitor drug candidates. The company has collaborations with Variational AI Inc. to develop AI-generated ATR inhibitor compounds; with Celvion Therapeutics to identify novel precision medicine strategies; and with NanoPalm Ltd. to develop an advanced delivery formulation for kt-3283, a bifunctional PARP-HDAC inhibitor that disrupts DNA repair and cellular survival mechanisms in cancer cells. Rakovina Therapeutics Inc. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
